notes.title: Shing! x Diesel Legacy: The Brazen Age
notes.content:
Hello y'all! 

Coming to you with quite the news packing your time with even more fun and action.

If you're looking for fast-paced thrills with a unique twist - Shing! and Diesel Legacy: The Brazen Age come together in a new Steam bundle.

Now, experience fluid, co-op beat ‘em up combat in Shing!, then dive into strategic 2v2 fighting in Diesel Legacy. Two distinct games, one great deal.

[h3]Check out the bundle and save[/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/48853/Shing_x_Diesel_Legacy_The_Brazen_Age/

notes.title: 💌 Experience Heartfelt Romance and Mystery in "Date Z" - Play the Demo Today!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35265814/773ae70e675f97abea0a1a93f9ea7b0d52ff13c7.png[/img]

[h1]Love, mystery, and survival await in "Date Z," an exciting indie game developed by Mass Creation.[/h1] 

[previewyoutube=P3SBkiugdZU;full][/previewyoutube]

As part of the Visual Novel Fest, the "Date Z" demo is now available on STEAM. Step into the shoes of a senior transfer student, where your survival depends on finding a date by Friday amidst a deadly zombie outbreak. Will you prioritize your love life or unravel the secrets of the apocalypse?

[b][h2]CHECK OUT THE DEMO AND ADD TO WISHLIST[/h2][/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1567890/Date_Z/

🌹 Immerse yourself in heartfelt romances with five unique characters, each with their own captivating personality and potential involvement in the unfolding mystery. Your choices will have lasting consequences, shaping your relationships and determining your fate.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35265814/72f96918d6362ddd368311c9528718eda5936252.jpg[/img]

🚪 Explore the intricate architecture of your school, uncovering hidden passages and secrets that may hold the key to your survival. Utilize a mysterious device to traverse through different timelines, revealing new scenarios that will deepen your immersion in the heart-racing adventure.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35265814/ff132b1c334d96e31c0b0662575da9648d7bafa1.jpg[/img]

🌟 Feature List:

[b]Choice-driven Visual Novel Dating Sim:[/b] Your decisions will influence the direction of the narrative and the relationships you form.
[b]Multiple Endings:[/b] Experience diverse outcomes based on the choices you make, ensuring a unique gameplay experience each time.
[b]Date Five Unique Characters:[/b] Engage in heartfelt romances with five distinct girls, each with their own individual personality and backstory.
[b]Explore Multiple Timelines: [/b]Utilize a mysterious device to navigate through different timelines, unveiling unique scenarios and deepening the immersion.
[b]School Campus Exploration: [/b]Unearth secrets within the intricate architecture of your school, where the key to survival may be closer than you think.
[b]Beautiful Comic-Style Visuals: [/b]Immerse yourself in the vibrant world of "Date Z," brought to life by stunning hand-drawn visuals.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35265814/0a4f06f162ec9b388d126ee7a53ff65c9cdd25c8.jpg[/img]

[h3]Discover "Date Z" today and experience an enthralling adventure filled with romance, mystery, and survival in a world gripped by a deadly zombie outbreak! 🌟[/h3]

notes.title: Shing! version 2.0.1
notes.content:
Hey All! 
We are in the process of Steam Deck verification, which is why we are adding some new updates to the game. Keep your fingers crossed, for the green mark we would like to achieve! 

[list]
[*]Improved text readability in some parts of UI
[*]Videos on some Proton versions now display properly
[*]Video and Controls settings do not sync via Steam Cloud anymore (some users may experience a complete reset of video settings and button bindings)
[/list]

As always - patch notes are available here: 
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1103730/discussions/0/2923353981937579918/

notes.title: Shing! version 2.0
notes.content:
Here it is! 
Shing! version 2.0 with all the improvements and features you've asked for (+ some you did not).

[list]
[*]Keyboard support - check! - Play without mouse aiming!
[*]Extra tutorials and How To's - check! - Check the in-game Pause Menu for a deep dive into various systems.
[*]Enemies balancing - check! - No more breaks in the battle flow. No more "3 times in a row" design!
[/list]
Go kill some Yokai! 

Patch notes are available here: 
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1103730/discussions/0/2923353981937579918/

notes.title: Shing! ver. 1.0.07 is available!
notes.content:
Hi all!

We're back with some changes, that we think you guys might find interesting!

[b]- BUGFIXES![/b]
- Fixed control scheme selection bug (you probably even did not notice that ;) )
- Fixed colliders on level 5
- Fixed Sound FX in Boss Fights
- Some small improvements with the controller responses, and overall controller usage

[b]- GAMEPLAY BALANCE CHANGES![/b]
- Changes in enemies AI

[b]- OPTIMIZATION[/b]
- Memory usage optimization 
- Particle usage optimization.

As always, please see [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1103730/discussions/0/2923353981937579918/]this forum thread[/url] for any additional pieces of information!

We hope, you guys will like what we prepared, and stay tuned for more!

notes.title: Aiko - playable character presentation
notes.content:
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/ZEHYvf2UF74qPDmbjO/source.gif[/img]

[h1]"Leave it to the professional."[/h1]

[b]Aiko[/b] is the last playable character we'd like to showcase! Well-read and curious, Aiko’s highly knowledgeable about the world and its history. She's confident in her abilities, and fully dedicated to her duties. In combat she shows open disdain to her enemies, and eggs her comrades on to keep up with her breakneck pace.

notes.title: Tetsuo - playable character presentation
notes.content:
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/dWx2YxPtRduboFPkjx/source.gif[/img]

[h1]"Man, I love my job!"[/h1]

He's young, he's handsome, and he's got some sick katana skills! Meet [b]Tetsuo[/b] - another playable character from Shing! Fun fact - you can parry and counter in Shing! Not like in some other hyped brawlers coming out.

notes.title: Bichiko - playable character presentation
notes.content:
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/ZBEAtYDcFa3BuFvypJ/source.gif[/img]

[h1]"Come closer, I don’t bite!"[/h1]

We present to you [b]Bichiko[/b], another playable character in Shing! 
In combat, she often shares advice and give encouragement to her allies – and sometimes to her enemies.

notes.title: Wilhelm - playable character presentation
notes.content:
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/m9ism3yjmUQExPkZ1j/source.gif[/img]

[h1]"Not bad! Now's my turn."[/h1]

Here's [b]Wilhelm[/b], one of four playable characters in Shing! 
Boastful, daring and merciless, Wilhelm sees himself as a pinnacle of manliness and a perfect warrior - a fact he constantly shares with everyone around him.
And as you can see - his weapon of choice is a kickass Axe!
